name: English
why: Communicate natively and confidently at work and in life
motivation: Listen to this soundtrack (30 minutes) at least twice a day, read out loud following the author, and at the same time write down every word of the speech on paper. Do it for a week — you won't notice any difference. Two weeks — you start to feel some difference. Do it every day for a month and you'll be a changed person when it comes to English.
